% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): scale only axis with an explicit
% size, placed with at and anchor; a marker on the picture origin.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\fill[red] (0,0) circle (1pt);
\begin{axis}[scale only axis, width=5cm, height=3cm, at={(2cm,1cm)}, anchor=north east]
\addplot coordinates {(0,0) (1,2) (2,1) (3,4)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
